name: arma3-sqf-reloader
description: Hot-reloads SQF functions in a running Arma 3 (or Eden Editor) through the SqfReloader REST API. Creates mod junctions automatically.

commands.title: SqfReloader: Play (start Arma 3 with this mod)
SqfReloader: Set up this mod (junction + config)
SqfReloader: Set up all mods in this workspace
SqfReloader: Create example mod (try the reloader)
SqfReloader: Remove junctions created by this extension

sqfReloader.armaDirectory.markdownDescription: Arma 3 installation folder (contains `arma3_x64.exe`). Leave empty to auto-detect from the registry / Steam libraries.

sqfReloader.enabled.description: Send SQF changes to Arma 3 when a file is saved.

sqfReloader.apiUrl.description: Base URL of the SqfReloader REST server (the SqfReloader mod must be running in Arma 3).

sqfReloader.requestTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a request to Arma.

sqfReloader.autoJunction.description: Create a junction from the Arma 3 folder to the open mod folder so Arma (and the reloader) can read the scripts from your working copy.

enumDescriptions: Link each PBO prefix (folder with $PBOPREFIX$) into <arma>\z\<tag>\addons\<name>. Works even when the mod folder lives anywhere.
Link the whole mod folder (@Mod) into <arma>\<@Mod>. Closest to the normal -mod= layout.
sqfReloader.junctionMode.description: How mod folders are linked into the Arma 3 directory.

enumDescriptions: Read the saved file from disk and recompile the TAG_fnc_name variable (recommended).
Send the file content through POST /api/command as a recompile request (compatible with the EdenOnline API).
sqfReloader.reloadOnSave.description: How a saved SQF file is pushed to Arma.

sqfReloader.notifyOnError.description: Show a notification when Arma is not reachable or a reload fails.

sqfReloader.extraLaunchArguments.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for `SqfReloader: Play`. `-filePatching`, `-mod=` and `-noBattlEye` are always added (file patching and the mod are required by the reloader, BattlEye cannot load the unsigned extension); set `-be` here to start it anyway.

sqfReloader.createExampleWithMission.markdownDescription: **SqfReloader: Create example mod** also writes `missions/example.Altis`, a minimal mission that calls the generated functions.
